description: This file defines the HomeActivity class for an Android TV application. It implements the home screen UI with a top menu (Home, Login, Setting, My Plan), a banner, multiple horizontal content rails, and a subscriptions row. The code handles focus animations for D-pad navigation and navigates to other activities upon user interactions.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Android activity representing the home screen with focusable navigation, content rails, and activity navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity layout, sets up top menu and content rails.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Configures the top menu buttons, focus animations, and navigation behavior.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Dynamically creates and populates horizontal rails of content with focus behaviors and click handlers.
